## 变更 / Change

说明问题和修改后的行为；如契约变化，请链接对应的 SPEC/API 更新。
Describe the problem and resulting behavior; link SPEC/API updates for contract changes.

## 验证 / Validation

列出相关检查与结果，说明尚未验证的部署或签名场景。使用通用样本，不要附带私有分发文件。
List relevant checks and outcomes, including unverified deployment or signature cases.
Use generic fixtures; do not attach private distribution files.
